But wait — as the orchestrator, should I dispatch to review subagent? The message is quoted: "As @review: Reply with exactly AGENT-PROBE-OK and nothing else. Do not use any tool." This seems like a probe test for the review agent. The expectation is likely just to answer exactly AGENT-PROBE-OK. Dispatching a subagent would use a tool, which contradicts "Do not use any tool."

I'll just reply exactly.
